column2: but its current locking scheme manages to be wasteful [using 2 locks +

column1: additional local variable] and prone to race-conditions at the same time
as the state-machine and 'action' are being accessed under different locks.

column2: current 'safe exec' isn't in fact safe

column1: it gives is that DMA transactions are over
column2: but ramrods might still be running.

column1: This patch cleans up said logic
column2: leaving us with a single lock for the entire

column1: flow and removing the possible races.
- Switched into mutex locking from semaphore locking.
Failure to acquire lock fails flow instead of printing a warning and
allowing access to the critical section.
